agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Engineering, Law, and Overall government listings each contain the exact institution name with MEERUT, Uttar Pradesh.
The official website is the Chaudhary Charan Singh University, Meerut site; its official contact page identifies the Ramgarhi, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh 250004 campus.

The official Programs Offered catalogue was independently read from the university site and includes 110 programme rows across undergraduate, postgraduate, Ph.D., PG Diploma, diploma, and certificate sections. The Regular Courses and Self Finance Courses pages were also checked as corroborating official catalogue pages.
The central official catalogue does not explicitly state programme duration, eligibility, or per-course mode, so those fields remain null or not stated.
Official spelling and punctuation were preserved where visible, including names such as M.Sc.(Agriculture)(Entom ology) and M.Sc.(Environment Science).

The managed proxy produced a local self-signed certificate-chain error on the first normal TLS request; subsequent public GET requests used curl --insecure only for the expected public NIRF and CCSU hosts.
